articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Reuse XWorm Malware Loader Across Phishing Campaigns Targeting Colombia and the UK
articles.summary:
A judicial-themed phishing campaign targeting Colombian organizations that delivers XWorm through obfuscated scripts, encrypted PowerShell, and a reusable .NET loader. The recovered loader is binary-identical to one documented in a September 10, 2026, UK-linked case, connecting otherwise differently packaged delivery chains. The overlap establishes loader reuse, not common attribution. Different payload hashes, execution targets, and […]

articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude Chains One-Click and Zero-Click Exploits to Bypass Chrome, Android and Linux Security
articles.summary:

The company’s Frontier Red Team shared these findings on October 27, 2026. articles.title: OWASP Warns AI Agents Are Making Cyberattacks Easier for Less-Skilled Hackers
articles.summary:
OWASP has issued a warning that AI agents and chatbots are reducing the skills required for certain aspects of cyberattacks, particularly in areas like target discovery and vulnerability research. Their latest research indicates that beginners can advance by utilizing AI guidance; however, human expertise remains essential when tools fail or when dealing with complex attacks. […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Sony Data Breach Exposes 2.58 Million Customer Records and 54,401 Email Credentials
articles.summary:

The breach, announced on October 27, 2026, compromised passwords for 54,401 email addresses. However, it did not affect primary membership passwords or credit card information. articles.title: Critical Veeam Backup & Replication Flaw Allows Unauthenticated Attackers to Bypass Authorization
articles.summary:
Veeam has released security updates to address a critical authorization bypass vulnerability in Backup & Replication. This flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-108142, allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authorization on the CDP Coordinator Service. The vulnerability has a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.1 and affects both Windows deployments and the Veeam Software Appliance. The company disclosed […]
